title: Exploit Chain: SQL Injection to Cross-User Appointment Data Exfiltration
description: Step 1: Attacker exploits SQL injection in VulnerableAppointmentRepository.findByStatus (finding-004, CWE-89) using payload to bypass status filter and retrieve appointments of ALL statuses. Step 2: SQL injection in findByCustomerIdAndStatus (finding-005, CWE-89) bypasses both customer_id and status filters to retrieve ALL appointments across ALL customers. Step 3: Confirmed via IDOR endpoints (finding-009,010, CWE-639) that appointments of other customers are accessible. Combined blast radius: complete appointment database exfiltration.
impact: Complete appointment database exfiltration across all customers and barbers. Attacker retrieves all appointments regardless of status, customer, or date range.
mitigation: 1) Replace all string concatenation with parameterized queries in VulnerableAppointmentRepository. 2) Use the safe methods (findByStatusSafe, etc.) as reference. 3) Add ownership verification in appointment endpoints.

history.details: Constructed by chaining findings finding-004, finding-005, finding-009, finding-010.
